scenes.heading: Building a signature framework or methodology

sents.d: Building a signature framework or methodology
A named process makes your approach easier to explain, sell, and deliver consistently.

A signature framework — a named, structured process you take clients through — makes your approach feel more concrete and easier to explain than 'we'll just talk it through,' which can feel vague to prospects evaluating you.

Building a framework usually starts by documenting the actual steps you already take successful clients through, then naming and refining that process rather than inventing something disconnected from what you actually do.
A clear framework also makes it easier to eventually delegate parts of delivery, create supporting materials (workbooks, templates), or turn the same core method into a group program or course.

take: Name and document the process you already use.
